Project local conversion is approximate, not survey control.

findings: Prior manifest/placement evidence remains applicable; R20 changes no transform.

Roof slab/parapet, L5 status, penthouse, floor intervals, and GIS 48-ft conflict remain unresolved.

findings: Official image shows brick-heavy massing and interrupted horizontal glazing on pictured faces.
Current model continues repeated broad glazing ribbons.
R20 fixes metadata only; exact face/window segmentation remains unsupported.

criteria.name: Interior and circulation
findings: Existing interior plan traces, fixtures, doors, and stairs remain schematic.
No newly digitized as-built stair/circulation source; route continuity is unverified.

criteria.name: Technical and evidence quality
findings: Saved asset reopened; 191 scene objects/169 meshes; four facade fingerprints match prior baseline; no unpacked images.
R20 corrects the R19 SVG: 2025 JSON and diagram now use the same camera/ray; 2009 pano values are separately recorded.

sightline_correction.status: Corrected in R20; previous R19 diagram used the 2009 panorama ray but labeled it as 2025.
sightline_correction.assessment: R20 JSON and SVG agree. This is a perspective sightline to a candidate GIS edge, not a calibrated elevation or a sufficient basis for exact window segmentation.

major_remaining_issues: Continuous glazing ribbons remain visibly different from interrupted glazing in the available photo.
No measured evidence resolves metric building height, roof/penthouse, L5 interpretation, or the GIS 48-ft conflict.
No digitized as-built circulation/stair plan verifies interior route dimensions or full level continuity.
The corrected sightline identifies only a candidate facade edge; perspective/occlusion prevents exact window measurement.
